review_findings.closed_by: Fit identity is reconstructed from verified canonical data and split before deserialization. All four fields are required and exact. Loaded channel/k/op/feature columns/rules/IF parameters, actual fit rows, feature dimensions, sample count and tree count are checked. No fit or full-fit rescoring occurs during load.

Existing targets fail before fit by default. Explicit --replace builds and verifies a sibling stage, archives the complete previous directory, then publishes. Build failure preserves the old bytes; simulated publish failure restores the old directory. Unsafe roots/containers and link/reparse paths are rejected.

A frozen load-time BundleIdentity binds model/recipe/manifest hashes and bundle_id to each verdict, batch row, anomaly, CombinedResult, stream._detector, and run. Save uses the held identity, including real zero-anomaly runs. Two valid same-version serializations are distinguishable; file switching does not relabel held results.

known_limits: Strict source/dependency byte fingerprints remain in force.
Process crash recovery between archive and publish is manual; complete old archive and stage are retained.
